extraMeanings.en: to make a low continuous sound
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My stomach was grumbling because I hadn't eaten all day.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bütün gün yemek yemediğim için midem guruldıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: a large difference between people or groups
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There is a widening gulf between the rich and the poor.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Zenginlerle yoksullar arasında giderek büyüyen bir uçurum var.

extraMeanings.en: a sudden swallow caused by fear or surprise
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She gave a nervous gulp before stepping onto the stage.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sahneye çıkmadan önce gergin bir şekilde yutkundu.

extraMeanings.en: frozen rain / to fall as frozen rain
extraMeanings.exampleEn: It began to hail as we drove through the mountains.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dağlardan geçerken dolu yağmaya başladı.

extraMeanings.en: to come from a particular place
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The famous author hails from a small town in Ireland.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ünlü yazar İrlanda'da küçük bir kasabadan gelmektedir.

extraMeanings.en: a stop or pause
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The train came to a sudden halt at the station.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tren istasyonda ani bir duraklamayla durdu.

extraMeanings.en: an advantage given in a sport to make competition fairer
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He plays golf off a handicap of ten.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: On handikapla golf oynuyor.

extraMeanings.en: to fasten something so it is supported from above
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Please hang your coat on the hook by the door.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Lütfen paltonu kapının yanındaki askıya as.

extraMeanings.en: the quality of being difficult to do or understand
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The hardness of the exam surprised even the best students.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sınavın zorluğu en iyi öğrencileri bile şaşırttı.

extraMeanings.en: to cause damage or injury to someone or something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Smoking can seriously harm your health.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sigara içmek sağlığınıza ciddi şekilde zarar verebilir.

extraMeanings.en: a large amount of stolen or illegal goods that has been seized
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Police seized a huge haul of drugs at the border.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Polis sınırda büyük bir uyuşturucu partisine el koydu.

extraMeanings.en: to make good use of an opportunity while it lasts
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The team made hay while their main rivals were injured.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Takım, başlıca rakipleri sakatken fırsattan yararlandı.

extraMeanings.en: a state of mental confusion
extraMeanings.exampleEn: For the first few days after the operation she was in a haze.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ameliyattan sonraki ilk birkaç gün zihni bulanıktı.

extraMeanings.en: not clear in the mind; vague
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My memory of that night is rather hazy.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: O geceye dair hatıralarım oldukça bulanık.

extraMeanings.en: to put things in a large untidy pile
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She heaped food onto his plate.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tabağına bir sürü yemek yığdı.

extraMeanings.en: a large amount of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We have heaps of time before the train leaves.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tren kalkmadan önce bir sürü vaktimiz var.

extraMeanings.tr: çok zor/kötü durum, işkence gibi durum
extraMeanings.en: a very unpleasant or difficult experience
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The last few months at work have been hell.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İşteki son birkaç ay tam bir cehennemdi.

extraMeanings.en: a plant used to add flavour to food
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She sprinkled fresh herbs over the pasta.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Makarnanın üzerine taze yeşillikler serpti.

extraMeanings.en: a very small amount of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There was a hint of garlic in the sauce.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sosta hafif bir sarımsak tadı vardı.

extraMeanings.en: to suggest something indirectly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She hinted that she might resign.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İstifa edebileceğini ima etti.

extraMeanings.en: without real value or sincerity
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Their promises turned out to be hollow.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Vaatlerinin içi boş çıktı.

extraMeanings.en: a hole or empty space in something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The rabbit hid in a hollow beneath the tree.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tavşan ağacın altındaki bir oyuğa saklandı.

extraMeanings.en: the neighbourhood where someone lives (informal)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He grew up in a tough hood on the east side.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Doğu yakasında zorlu bir mahallede büyüdü.

extraMeanings.en: to fasten or catch something with a hook
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He hooked the fish and reeled it in.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Balığı oltaya taktı ve makarayı sararak çekti.

extraMeanings.en: a catchy part of a song
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The song has a great hook that stays in your head.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şarkının aklından çıkmayan harika bir nakaratı var.

extraMeanings.en: to chase or harass someone continually
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The reporters hounded her for weeks after the scandal.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Muhabirler skandaldan sonra haftalarca peşini bırakmadı.

extraMeanings.en: a period of silence
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A hush fell over the crowd as the singer walked on.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şarkıcı sahneye çıkınca kalabalığı bir sessizlik kapladı.

extraMeanings.en: something made by combining two different things
extraMeanings.exampleEn: This car is a hybrid that runs on both petrol and electricity.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu araba hem benzinle hem elektrikle çalışan bir hibrittir.

extraMeanings.en: a famous person regarded as a symbol
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She became a fashion icon in the 1960s.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: 1960'larda bir moda ikonu oldu.

extraMeanings.en: very unfriendly or hostile
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She gave me an icy stare and left the room.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bana buz gibi bir bakış attı ve odadan çıktı.

extraMeanings.en: to feel that you understand and share someone's feelings
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Many readers identify with the novel's main character.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Birçok okur romanın ana karakteriyle özdeşleşiyor.

extraMeanings.en: (of an engine) to run slowly while not in gear
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He left the car idling outside the shop.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Arabayı dükkânın önünde rölantide bıraktı.

extraMeanings.en: without purpose or good reason
extraMeanings.exampleEn: These are just idle threats; he won't do anything.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bunlar sadece boş tehditler; hiçbir şey yapmayacak.

extraMeanings.en: a foolish person (said affectionately)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: You idiot, you forgot to lock the door again!
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Seni salak, kapıyı yine kilitlemeyi unutmuşsun!
